name: OX Quiz Widget - Browser
description: Educational OX (true/false) quiz interface for browser. No native APIs, no external services.

requirement.summary: Build a React OX quiz with 3 questions, immediate feedback, progress tracking, score calculation, and retry functionality.
details: Display one question at a time out of 3 total questions
Show O (true) and X (false) answer buttons
After selecting an answer, display whether it is correct or incorrect with explanation text
Prevent further answer changes for the current question after selection
Display progress indicator (e.g., '2/3 completed') and a visual progress bar
Calculate score: 10 points per correct answer, max 30 points total
When all 3 questions are answered, show final score and summary (e.g., '2/3 correct - 20 points')
Provide a 'Retry' or 'Start Over' button that completely resets the quiz to question 1 with no answers selected and score = 0
Responsive design: optimize for mobile phones (320px) to tablets (768px)
Accessibility: keyboard navigation (Tab focus, Enter/Space to select), visible focus rings, aria-live regions for score and feedback
Color scheme: green for correct answers, red for incorrect answers, gray for neutral/unanswered states
Use system default font stack (Tailwind font-sans)
Component structure: App (main container and state), QuestionCard (displays question text), AnswerButtons (O/X buttons with disabled state), ProgressBar (text + visual), ResultScreen (final score)
State management: currentQuestionIndex, userAnswers (array of booleans), correctAnswers (array), totalScore, isComplete
Include 3 hardcoded sample quiz questions with question text, correct answer (true/false), and explanation. Questions should be educational and self-contained.
